# Cove IVF Tracker

> Cove is a patient-facing organizer for clinic-directed fertility treatment. It keeps medication schedules, injections, appointments and cycle records together. It does not provide medical advice or predict treatment outcomes.

Product information updated: 12 October 2026.

## Availability

- iPhone and iPad: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6788749556
- Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.mohamedamer.cove
- Store availability, supported devices and features can vary by version and country. Check the relevant listing.

## Who it is for

Cove focuses on organizing a clinic-directed IVF cycle, including retrieval and frozen embryo transfer. Cove records the instructions a clinic provides; it does not choose a protocol. It is not a period tracker, ovulation predictor or clinic EHR.

## How protocol capture works

1. Photograph the clinic medication sheet, or use an available text, voice or PDF capture option.
2. Review the draft against the original instructions. Check medication names, doses, units, dates and times, and correct extraction errors.
3. Confirm before saving. Keep the clinic instructions as the source of truth and ask the clinic about anything unclear.

AI extraction can make mistakes. Cove does not validate the clinical appropriateness of a dose. It does not have a live feed from a clinic portal.

## Organization features

Medication schedules and reminders; injection-site records; medication inventory; appointments and monitoring records; separate cycle histories; expenses; journal and hydration logs. The current iOS listing also describes Embryo Bank and optional Cycle Pal peer support. Check each platform listing for its current feature set.

## Reminders and privacy controls

Notification delivery depends on device settings, permissions and operating-system behavior. iOS notifications do not bypass silent mode. Android full-screen alarms depend on permission and device support. Set an independent backup alarm for time-critical medication, including the trigger shot.

Detailed reminders are enabled by default. Medication names can be hidden from lock-screen reminders in Settings → Notifications.

## Pricing

Cove offers auto-renewing subscriptions. The purchase screen shows the local price, full billing amount, billing interval, included features, renewal terms and any eligible trial before purchase. Offers and eligibility vary by store and user. A free download does not mean all features are free. Do not infer a universal subscription price from an old article or the store list of in-app purchase products.

## Data practices

Account and treatment data are stored in the cloud and encrypted in transit and at rest. Cove does not sell treatment details or share them for advertising. Cove does not show in-app ads.

AppsFlyer measures device and campaign activity and non-health conversion events; it does not receive medication, laboratory or journal content. iOS tracking permission controls access to IDFA. Product analytics and limited non-IDFA measurement may still operate when tracking permission is declined. See the privacy policy for details.

Protocol photos are processed for draft extraction and are not retained after processing. Uploaded lab PDFs are stored privately until deleted. Account deletion is available in Settings. Optional Cycle Pal messages are not end-to-end encrypted.
